deviations: The committed snapshot.json pins rtk 0.50.0; the machine has rtk 0.52.0, so the unmodified verb exits 4 (tool drift) before measuring. The run used a scratch copy of snapshot.json that differs only in the rtk versionLine (0.50.0 -> 0.52.0). A routes that call rtk therefore ran on 0.52.0.

The cached HF snapshot directory holds symlinks to blobs and is rejected by the production model inspector (unsafe-artifact). SEMBLE_MODEL_PATH is a symlink-dereferenced local copy of the same files; nothing was downloaded.
python3 on PATH has no semble; a wrapper script exec-ing the Semble 0.6.1 tool venv python was placed first on PATH (production default interpreter is python3, no option is passed by the bench).
